title: Half expectation as a convolution
statement: Let $F$ be a family indexed by pairs of bits and taking real-valued functions on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, let $b\in\mathbb F_2$, and let $y:\mathrm{Fin}(1)\to\mathbb F_2^n$. The half expectation obtained by fixing the last index to $b$ equals the normalized additive convolution of the functions indexed by $(0,b)$ and $(1,b)$, evaluated at $y(0)$.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ is a Gowers family of order $2$
